cloudrun.name: Sanitize workspace package shadows
Build and Deploy to Cloud Run
cloudrun.run:
gcloud run deploy ${SERVICE_NAME} \
  --source "apps/${APP_NAME}" \
  --region ${REGION} \
  --platform managed \
  --allow-unauthenticated \
  --memory "${MEMORY_LIMIT}" \
  --cpu "${CPU_LIMIT}" \
  --min-instances 0 \
  --max-instances 10 \
  --service-account "${GCP_WORKLOAD_SA}" \
  --update-env-vars=PROJECT_ID=${PROJECT_ID},GCP_PROJECT_ID=${PROJECT_ID},FIREBASE_API_KEY=${{ secrets.FIREBASE_API_KEY }},FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=${{ secrets.FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN }}

event-worker.name: Sanitize workspace package shadows

gke-autopilot.name: Sanitize workspace package shadows
Deploy to GKE Autopilot Cluster
gke-autopilot.run:
if ! gcloud container clusters describe gke-fd4at --region ${REGION} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "GKE Autopilot cluster 'gke-fd4at' is still being provisioned by OpenTofu. Skipping workflow run until cluster is ready."
  exit 0
fi
gcloud container clusters get-credentials gke-fd4at --region ${REGION}
if [ -d "k8s" ]; then kubectl apply -f k8s/; fi
